question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.**

Writing down instructions, steps and remembering them can make you look really efficient and ________.
solution: The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'diligent.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: • diligent​- hard-working and attentive to detail. (मेहनती, परिश्रमी) • dormant​- inactive or asleep. (निष्क्रिय, सुप्त, सुषुप्त)​ • operable- capable of being used or operated. (प्रचलित) • sluggish- slow-moving or inactive. (सुस्त, आलसी, निष्क्रिय, मंथर, मंदगति) • The context of the sentence is that writing down instructions and steps and remembering them can make a person look efficient and hard-working. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "diligent." • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1. • Another example: • *He made a **diligent** attempt to learn Russian.* Complete Sentence:__ *Writing down instructions, steps and remembering them can make you look really efficient and __diligent*.__ 41:Taa67,
